title: Sun Lei's Gamble
summary: Sun Lei hides from the immortal-beast food and then meets Wang Lin in the collapsing Immortal Beast Palace, admitting he is not really a Da Lou disciple but an infiltrator who kills for treasure. He proposes they work together to take three Celestial treasures guarded in the cave: a piece of immortal jade, an immortal sword and a piece of golden iron. Wang Lin asks for the Da Lou Mixun Search Technique and the Spirit Washing Gourd, and settles for the technique plus a promised Spirit Washing Wood. Together they thin the swarms with Sun Lei's Nine Rainbow Smoke and Wang Lin's Thunder Toad, and Sun Lei freezes the great black beast for ten breaths with a sect treasure to grab the treasures behind an immortal restriction. The beast breaks free early because Wang Lin has planned for it, so Sun Lei, cornered, blows himself up, and the whole celestial fragment begins to collapse.
events: Sun Lei confronts Wang Lin and admits he infiltrated the Da Lou Sword Sect
He lists three Celestial treasures: immortal jade, an immortal sword and golden iron
Wang Lin takes the Mixun Search Technique and a promised Spirit Washing Wood as his price
They lure and kill swarms of immortal-beast food; Wang Lin's Thunder Toad fights
Sun Lei freezes the black beast for ten breaths and runs for the treasures
The beast breaks loose after eight breaths; Sun Lei realises Wang Lin set him up
Sun Lei self-detonates and the fragment starts to collapse
cultivation: Sun Lei notes Wang Lin shows only early Soul Formation but must be hiding his real cultivation.
